content: Designed and launched a vendor performance scorecard, from visual design and badge framework to technical implementation and impact measurement.
Paired vendor-facing scorecards with manager-facing coaching reports, designing for both sides of the performance conversation.
Collaborated cross-functionally with Operations, IT, data scientists, and UX design, iterating on user feedback throughout to sharpen the communication.
Led a post-launch evaluation to measure whether the product achieved its goals, creating visualizations to communicate the results to stakeholders.

content.header: A Key Product Decision: Rethinking How Reports Reach Vendors
content: The original ask was to email scorecards directly to vendors. I identified this as a problem before implementation and led the effort to gain buy-in for my proposed solution.
Analytics was not a vendor-facing team, and handling vendor questions via email at scale would require standing up and monitoring a ticketing system, adding significant overhead.
The solution: embed the report directly within the vendor portal, where vendors already had an established relationship and support infrastructure.

This reframe meant vendors could access their reports in context, and any follow-up questions could be routed through an existing support process, removing analytics from the communication loop entirely.
This decision was based on team structure, security considerations, and designing for scale rather than just the immediate deliverable.
Designed a gamified badge system in four performance tiers: Gold, Silver, Bronze, and Trial, representing performance levels across specific service areas.

Badge design reflects the visual language of metallic awards while incorporating a ribbon element to reinforce the temporary, dynamic nature of the recognition. Badges are earned monthly, not permanently.
Flexible horizontal layout allows badges to display cleanly within table rows in the report.
Collaborated with a designer to execute my vision for the badges. Thank you!

After launch, led a post-launch evaluation to assess measurable impact of the scorecard product.
Collaborated with the Operations team and data scientists to identify key metrics and surface data gaps.
Created a scorecard lifecycle diagram to map the product's cyclic nature, illustrating how vendors enter, move through the work order and scorecard phases, and exit, to anchor the impact narrative.
/scorecard_lifecycle.png
Designed an overview page with main takeaways to precede detailed metric analysis, giving stakeholders a clear entry point before diving into the numbers.
Structured metric display from most generic to most specific, left to right, to guide readers through the data naturally.
The scorecard initiative generated $2.5M in cost savings within the first six months of launch, validated through the post-launch metric evaluation.
